name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: Enable users to easily find nearby recycling facilities and relevant information such as operational hours and accepted materials.
Allow users to manage their recycling preferences, save favorite facilities, and receive tailored notifications.
Assist users in scheduling and planning their recycling activities efficiently, considering their availability and waste types.
Safeguard users' personal information and maintain the integrity of all data within the application.
Ensure that all recycling facility data displayed to users is current, correct, and comprehensive.
Provide channels for users to submit feedback and receive support, and for administrators to address these inputs effectively.
Enable effective communication between administrators and recycling facility representatives to ensure smooth operations and information exchange.
Allow facility representatives to directly update and maintain their facility's information on the platform.
Guarantee that the information presented about their facility to users is always correct and up-to-date.
Provide a direct channel for facility representatives to communicate issues or concerns to the site administrators.
lowLevelGoals: The system shall allow the user to retrieve a list of recycling facilities within a specified radius of their current location.
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed recycling facilities based on the types of materials they accept.
The system shall allow the user to view detailed information for a selected recycling facility, including operational hours, address, contact information, and accepted materials.
The system shall allow the user to save a recycling facility to their list of favorite facilities.
The system shall allow the user to set their preferred recycling material types and notification preferences.
The system shall send the user notifications based on their saved preferences, such as facility updates or recycling reminders.
The system shall allow the user to schedule a recycling pickup for specific waste types at a chosen date and time.
The system shall allow the user to view a calendar or list of their upcoming recycling activities.
The system shall allow the user to modify or cancel a previously scheduled recycling activity.
The system shall encrypt all user personal information stored in the database.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict unauthorized access to user data.
The system shall anonymize user usage data before it is used for analytics or reporting.
The system shall allow the administrator to add new recycling facility information, including name, address, contact, hours, and accepted materials.
The system shall allow the administrator to modify existing recycling facility details.
The system shall allow the administrator to remove a recycling facility from the system.
The system shall allow the administrator to view and categorize user-submitted feedback.
The system shall allow the administrator to send a response to a user regarding their feedback or support request.
The system shall automatically generate support tickets for critical user issues or feedback.
The system shall allow the administrator to send notifications or updates to specific recycling facility representatives.
The system shall allow the administrator to receive and view queries or concerns submitted by facility representatives.
The system shall allow the facility representative to update their facility's name, address, contact details, and operational hours.
The system shall allow the facility representative to add or remove accepted material types for their facility.
The system shall allow the facility representative to view their facility's public profile as it appears to users.
The system shall allow the facility representative to receive notifications from administrators regarding system updates or important announcements.
The system shall allow the facility representative to submit a query or report an issue directly to the site administrators.
